name: Three studies of Chinese figures
dimensions: The paper cut across the upper right corner.
summary: Two drawings depicting a pair of gamblers sitting on the ground, one of them (LL, at 90°) with an additional stooping spectator.  In the third drawing (UC, inverted) a figure stands in a small Tanka boat partially covered in thatch.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
